programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A group of small town High School students, including an introverted photographer and a drug dealer, begin to suspect something's off with their teachers. They realize that the faculty is under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A masked killer continues to pursue a California student (Neve Campbell) and her friends at an Ohio college.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After a shady investor steals their new invention, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) conspire to kidnap the man's adult son and ransom him to pay off their debts.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie
programme.sub-title: House at the End of the Street (2012)

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Movie

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Badmash No.1
programme.desc: Ram, the son of Bhavani Shankar, and Anjali, the daughter of Narasimha, fall in love with each other while living abroad. Upon their return to India, they try to reunite their warring fathers.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Godli Soda
programme.desc: Bollywood action starring Priyanka Jain,Vikram, 2014.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Main Hoon Chaalbaaz
programme.desc: Gudumba Shankar falls in love with Gowri and finds out that she is being forced to marry Kumar Swamy, a gangster. Shankar must find a way to stop him and save Gowri.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: A boy genius in the 1960s finds his way into a spectacular futuristic metropolis while attempting to promote his idea for a jetpack. Decades later, he has grown into a disillusioned adult, while a girl who has the talent and enthusiasm he has lost also finds her way into this strange new world, and together they attempt to uncover its secrets. Fantasy adventure inspired by the theme park, starring George Clooney, Britt Robertson and Hugh Laurie.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Forky Asks A Question
programme.desc: What Is Time?Rex uses the age of dinosaurs as an example to give Forky an understanding of the concept of time.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Arms manufacturer Tony Stark is taken hostage by a terrorist group and realises the weapons his company build have been falling into the wrong hands. Using his engineering skills to construct a hi-tech armoured suit, he manages to escape and then puts the technology to good use in the fight against evil around the world. Superhero adventure, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow and Terrence Howard.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen arrives in an isolated community of youngsters, with no memory of who he is or the outside world. When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: A sideshow performer is taken in by a scientist, who seeks his help in performing experiments to create life, and hopefully uncover the secrets of immortality. The plan goes dangerously out of control, and it falls to the devoted assistant to save his master from his dark obsessions and his monstrous creation. Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe.

programme.title: Captain America: Civil War
programme.desc: The superhuman soldier is propelled into conflict with his Avengers teammate Iron Man over a system of government control over their actions - a situation made worse when an old friend is accused of being behind a terror attack. As a cunning conspiracy surrounds them all, Captain America finds himself battling former allies, vengeful enemies, and new heroes on the block Black Panther and Spider-Man. Superhero adventure, starring Chris Evans, Robert Downey Jr and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: A doting dad is taken aback when his daughter announces she is getting married, and is thrown into a whirlwind of increasingly complicated wedding plans, a struggle to live up to the expectations of his wealthy future in-laws and the sad realisation that his little girl has grown up. Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: The Bob's Burgers Movie
programme.desc: Bob Belcher and wife Linda run a hamburger restaurant in a close-knit seaside community. Stress piles on the couple's shoulders when a water main ruptures and creates a huge sinkhole in front of their business. Meanwhile, Belcher children Tina, Gene and Louise solve a murderous mystery. Animated comedy, with the voices of H John Benjamin, John Roberts, Kristen Schaal and Dan Mintz.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Cool Runnings
programme.desc: A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Maxie Gorman Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert H. Harris And Terence de Marney. Two men join forces to get into the bootlegging business but one man does not want to split the profits.

programme.title: Madron
programme.desc: 1970. Western. Director: Jerry Hopper. Stars Richard Boone, Leslie Caron And Gabi Amrani. A gunfighter and a French-Canadian nun who survived a massacre, set out on a trek to elude Apache warriors. [S]

programme.title: The Better Milk Story
programme.desc: A short film about JOBS Dairy. Meet the free range cows and learn about the milking methods, from the field to the doorstep in 1962!

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: An Egg Grows in Gotham. 1966. Stars Adam West, Vincent Price And Edward Everett Horton. Egghead and his yeggs steal the Gotham City charter in a twisted plot to gain control of the city. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Yegg Foes in Gotham. 1966. Stars Adam West, Vincent Price And Gail Hire. The city's ownership has reverted to Egghead, who fires all city officials and opens the metropolis to the underworld. [S]

programme.title: Theirs Is The Glory
programme.desc: 1946. War. Director: Brian Desmond Hurst. The story of the armies' heroic struggle to hold the vital Arnheim Bridge during World War II. Over 200 veterans took part, although no credits appear. [S]

programme.title: It's a Great Day
programme.desc: 1955. Starring Ruth Dunning, Edward Evans, Sidney James, Sheila Sweet, Peter Bryant, Nancy Roberts and Vera Day. Comedy based on the hugely successful TV series 'The Groves'. [S]

programme.title: Anna Christie
programme.desc: 1930. Drama. Director: Clarence Brown. Stars Greta Garbo And Charles Bickford. A young woman reunites with her father and falls in love with a sailor but struggles to tell them about her dark past. [S]

programme.title: For The Love of Benji
programme.desc: 1977. Director: Joe Camp. Stars Patsy Garrett, Cynthia Smith, Peter Bowles And Art Vasil. A lovable canine gets caught up in an international espionage plot while on a family vacation in Greece.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Man...
programme.desc: ...Who Walked Out On Himself. 1953. Stars Ronald Colman And Francis Pierlot. A wealthy clubman leaves his family to marry a much younger woman, prompting his mirror image to walk out on him. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Traitor. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips And Jennifer Jayne. The leader of a resistance group sends for Tell and Hedda to help him weed out a traitor but they soon find out they are in a trap. [S]

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: (AKA: The Long Rope). 1953. Drama. Director: Wolf Rilla. Stars Donald Houston, Susan Shaw And Peter Byrne. A man returns to where he was accused of murdering a girl to prove his innocence. [S]

programme.title: Turn The Key Softly

programme.title: Apocalypse D-Day
programme.desc: E2June 6, 1944: Thanks to a lull in the weather, the Allied armada launches an assault on the Normandy coast. On the five landing beaches, barges unload soldiers in successive waves.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E1A look at the women surrounding Hitler once he came to power, and how they were held up as the Aryan Ideal to strive for once the Nazi dictator approved of their positions.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E2How women were active - and often violent participants and perpetrators - in the conflict and its attendant atrocities - especially the Holocaust.

programme.title: D Day: 100 Days To Beat The Third Reich
programme.desc: E2This documentary will bring back to life the 100 days it took for the Allies to liberate Normandy, to break through the German line and to pave the way towards victory. 100 critical days, both heroic and tragic, that made history.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E4In the 19th century, weapons became more sophisticated and more deadly, and the results were higher casualties with devastating wounds.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E1On the orders of Adolf Hitler, the Nazi invaders of Alderney, a tiny island in the English Channel, shipped in more than 5,000 slave labourers to build an astonishing series of fortifications designed to protect the island from attack.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E2The killings carried out by the Nazis on Alderney during World War II represent the worst mass murder in British history, yet no one has been brought to justice.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E1From the battlefields of World War II to the jungles of Vietnam, this episode examines the weapons that changed modern warfare. The German STG 44, history’s first true assault rifle, revolutionised infantry tactics.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E2Blades that once decided the fate of nations take centre stage. Jason and Bruce handle a Viking sword, an artefact forged for raiders who terrorised Europe’s coasts. They then reveal Tantia Topee’s sword, carried by the legendary Indian leader.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E1A look at the men in charge, whose rampant egos and misguided belief in their own abilities led to their country making fatal mistakes in the war.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E3Ordinary objects can become extraordinary when pulled from the battlefield. In this episode, Jason and Bruce explore a regimental band cornet, owned by a band member who tragically died during the infamous Battle of Isandlwana.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E4Escape and survival in war often came down to ingenuity and courage. Jason and Bruce showcase miniature escape compasses, cunningly disguised inside RAF tunic buttons and belt buckles to help downed airmen find their way home.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E2Exploring how the seeds of Japan's defeat in 1945 were sown a decade earlier with the occupation of Manchuria in China.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E3The United Kingdom is isolated as German forces occupy Europe. 17,000 Trains carry German armies towards the Soviet Union. With Operation Barbarossa Hitler launches Vernichtungskrieg, a war of annihilation.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E1Mussolini joins Hitler in his fight against the Allies, while Winston Churchill is appointed British Prime Minister on the day of the Blitzkrieg, the German invasion of France.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E2Germany continues to build its empire in Europe, occupying Poland, Czechoslovakia, Austria, Luxembourg, Norway, Denmark, The Netherlands and Belgium. France is conquered and divided as Churchill rejects any attempt at an armistice.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E2The killings carried out by the Nazis on Alderney during World War II represent the worst mass murder in British history, yet no one has been brought to justice.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E3Adolf Hitler's father was a violent, abusive man. His mother doted on her young son. This episode delves deep into the psychology of Hitler as the narcissistic child who grew into a malignant psychopath full of rage and deep hatred.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E4Four women who had the misfortune to be pursued by Hitler saw only one way out of the relationship. His beloved niece took her own life and a German film star he was seeing fell from a balcony to her death.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E1Adolf Hitler had a depraved sex life that he tried to keep hidden from the German public. He was said to be a chronic masturbator, a voyeur and that he engaged in sado-masochistic sex with women.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E2Hitler wanted the world to believe he possessed super-human qualities but in private he was a wreck. This episode reveals the archives that confirm Hitler’s genital deformity, the alarming truth about his heavy drug addiction and the Parkinson’s.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4Two of the most produced combat machines in World War II managed to stay relevant until the end of the war through constant modernization and new variants.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E8This episode features tales of the heroism of the railway staff during the Blitz, and how a small siding in a Hampshire railway station played its part in the preparations for D-Day.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Hero No. 1

programme.title: Wallander - vålnaden
programme.desc: S2 E10 — VålnadenEtt hus brinner ner efter en gasexplosion. En man och en kvinna dör. Snart konstateras mordbrand. När man identifierar den döda mannen så vecklar en intrikat provkarta av svek och hemliga kärleksaffärer ut sig. Den bedragna mannen, och tillika mordoffrets kompanjon, misstänks omedelbart av alla, tills han också hittas brutalt mördad i sitt hem. Wallander söker sig tillbaka i männens förflutna och hittar tillslut en trolig gärningsman, på långväga besök, vars uppdrag ännu inte är slutfört. Inte förrän hans dotter får träffa sin döda pappa livs levande igen.

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: Som vinder af 2019 Emmy® Award-prisen for fremragende, animeret program fortsætter The Simpsons med at vække genklang hos seere for uærbødigt at lave sjov med alt og alle. Med dens yderliggående humor og herlige vid har serien gjort et uudsletteligt indtryk på amerikansk popkultur, og dets familiemedlemmer - Homer (Dan Castellaneta), Marge (Julie Kavner), Bart (Nancy Cartwright), Lisa (Yeardley Smith) og Maggie - er tv-ikoner. Som den længst kørende, nedskrevne serie i tv-historien har den Emmy® Award-, Annie Award- og Peabody Award-vindende, animerede komedie overgået Gunsmokes rekord for flest episoder af en nedskrevet, primetime tv-serie. The Simpsons er en Gracie Films produktion i samarbejde med 20th Century Fox Television. Serien blev skabt af Matt Groening og udviklet af James L. Brooks, Matt Groening og Sam Simon. James L. Brooks og Matt Groening er executive producere. Al Jean og Matt Selman er også executive producere og seriens showrunners.

programme.desc: Wutausbrüche, Ängste, Schlafprobleme - jedes fünfte Kind in Deutschland fühlt sich psychisch überdurchschnittlich belastet. Was ist eine Phase? Wann braucht ein Kind Hilfe? Autorin und Podcasterin Julia Knörnschild geht für ARD Wissen auf eine persönliche Reise: Sie begleitet den vierzehnjährigen Elias in einer Münchner Tagesklinik und trifft Mareike, die über Monate einen Therapieplatz für ihre Tochter sucht. programme.title: Landfrauenküche

programme.title: Servicezeit

programme.title: Natur im Garten
programme.desc: Wissenswertes und Nützliches zum naturnahen Gärtnern - präsentiert von Karl Ploberger. Aus den Schaugärten in Tulln gibt er Tipps zu Pflanzenkunde, Pflege, Gartenplanung und Lifestyle.

programme.title: Unterwegs beim Nachbarn

programme.title: Brahmaputra - Der große Fluss vom Himalaya

programme.title: Terra Mater
programme.desc: Der kurze Sommer in Alaska entscheidet über Leben und Überleben. In wenigen Wochen müssen Tiere genügend Reserven für die langen, harten Wintermonate anlegen.

programme.title: Mythos Wal
programme.desc: Eine Schallplatte hat wohl die Liebe der Menschen zu den Walen geweckt. Der Gesang der Buckelwale. War das Abschlachten der Wale jahrhundertelang ein weltweit lukrativer Wirtschaftszweig, riskieren seither Walretter ihr Leben, um einen einzigen Meeressäuger vor dem qualvollen Ersticken zu bewahren. Wie geschah es, dass sich das Verhältnis von Mensch und Wal so radikal veränderte?

programme.title: Die Weihnachtsinsel und der Palmendieb
programme.desc: Auf der Weihnachtsinsel im Indischen Ozean findet man Krebse überall, nicht nur im Meer: hoch oben in den Palmen, im Wald, auf dem Golfplatz, in Tempeln und in den tiefsten Höhlen.

programme.title: Die verrückte Welt der Tintenfische
programme.desc: In den Tiefen der Meere leben Tiere mit unglaublichen Fähigkeiten. Knochenlose Kreaturen, die Farbe und Form verändern können. Saugnäpfe machen sie zu effizienten Jägern:

programme.title: Faszination Südsee - Die Fidschi-Inseln
programme.desc: In den Weiten des Südpazifiks liegt die Republik Fidschi. Die meisten der gut 300 Fidschi-Inseln sind verwitterte Spitzen erloschener Vulkane. Steile Berge und weiße Strände bestimmen das Bild der Landschaft. Die schmalen Strandstreifen und die Küstenregionen der Inseln sind am dichtesten besiedelt. Aber je weiter man ins Landesinnere kommt, umso schwieriger werden die Lebensumstände. Es herrschen tropische Hitze und Dauerregen, die Hänge der Vulkane sind von dichtem Urwald bedeckt. Der Film spürt dem Leben der Menschen auf Fidschi nach und führt in eine faszinierende Inselwelt im Südpazifik.

programme.title: Waterwoman
programme.desc: In der Doku-Reihe Waterwoman erlebt die erfolgreichste deutsche Freitaucherin Anna von Boetticher die Faszination des Elements Wasser an einigen der spektakulärsten Orte der Erde.

programme.title: Das Herz von Hawaii - Die Insel Oahu
programme.desc: Sie liegen am anderen Ende der Welt und haben die Vorstellung vom Paradies geprägt: die insgesamt 137 Inseln des hawaiianischen Archipels. Hawaii ist der 50. Bundesstaat der USA und trägt den Beinamen The Aloha State. Dieses Aloha ist in Hawaii weitaus mehr als nur eine Grußformel. Es spiegelt ein Lebensgefühl wider und symbolisiert die Gelassenheit und Gastfreundlichkeit der Einheimischen, die vielfältige und üppige Natur, das endlose Meer und die immer scheinende Sonne Hawaiis.

programme.title: ZIB
programme.desc: Die Kurzausgaben der österreichischen Nachrichtensendung Zeit im Bild (ZIB) liefern neben klassischen Nachrichten Informationen über Entwicklungen auf den Finanzmärkten und Expertenanalysen.

programme.title: Kulturzeit
programme.desc: Kulturzeit ist das werktägliche Kulturmagazin von 3sat. Kulturzeit mischt sich in kulturelle und gesellschaftspolitische Fragen ein. Das Magazin bietet Hintergrundinformationen, Porträts und Gespräche zu aktuellen und brisanten Fragen.

programme.title: nano
programme.desc: Wutausbrüche, Ängste, Schlafprobleme - jedes fünfte Kind in Deutschland fühlt sich psychisch überdurchschnittlich belastet. Was ist eine Phase? Wann braucht ein Kind Hilfe? Autorin und Podcasterin Julia Knörnschild geht für ARD Wissen auf eine persönliche Reise: Sie begleitet den vierzehnjährigen Elias in einer Münchner Tagesklinik und trifft Mareike, die über Monate einen Therapieplatz für ihre Tochter sucht. Die emotionale Doku zeigt praktische Wege zur Hilfe, macht Mut und wirbt für mehr Offenheit im Umgang mit einem Thema, das viele Familien betrifft.

programme.title: Das Herz von Hawaii - Die Insel Oahu
programme.desc: Sie liegen am anderen Ende der Welt und haben die Vorstellung vom Paradies geprägt: die insgesamt 137 Inseln des hawaiianischen Archipels. Hawaii ist der 50. Bundesstaat der USA und trägt den Beinamen The Aloha State. Dieses Aloha ist in Hawaii weitaus mehr als nur eine Grußformel. Es spiegelt ein Lebensgefühl wider und symbolisiert die Gelassenheit und Gastfreundlichkeit der Einheimischen, die vielfältige und üppige Natur, das endlose Meer und die immer scheinende Sonne Hawaiis.

programme.title: Waterwoman
programme.desc: In der Doku-Reihe Waterwoman erlebt die erfolgreichste deutsche Freitaucherin Anna von Boetticher die Faszination des Elements Wasser an einigen der spektakulärsten Orte der Erde.

programme.title: Traumjobs: Von der Lehre an die Spitze
programme.desc: Vier namhafte Vorarlberger, die es mit einem Lehrabschluss in die Unternehmensführung und darüber hinausgeschafft haben: Stephanie Rist, Kerstin Palla, Udo Filzmaier und Rainer Ostermann.

programme.title: Servicezeit
programme.desc: Das Verbraucher- und Ratgebermagazin mit Yvonne Willicks und Dieter Könnes gibt praktische Ratschläge zu Themen wie Gesundheit, Geld, Wohnen und Ernährung.

programme.title: Querbeet
programme.desc: Adventsdeko aus dem Garten – Aus Zweigen, Beeren und Tannengrün entsteht bei Sabrina Nitsche stimmungsvolle Adventsdeko – natürlich, nachhaltig und fast alles aus dem Garten. Rewild your garden (3) – Naturgartenplaner David Seifert verwandelt einen konventionellen in einen artenreichen Naturgarten – mit Trockenmauer, Wasserflächen, wilden Stauden und naturnahen Wegen fürs Auge und für die Artenvielfalt. Urban Jungle in Bayern – Im Wohnzimmer ein grüner Dschungel? Duschen mit Lianen von der Decke? Überall grünt und wuchert es. Der Urban Jungle ist ein Trend, der auch in Bayern zu finden ist. Besuche bei Menschen und ihren grünen Oasen und Tipps und Tricks zum erfolgreichen Dschungelgärtnern. Hausbäume für kleine Gärten – Die Grundstücke sind im Laufe der letzten Jahre immer kleiner geworden. Klassische Haus- oder Hofbäume sind dafür viel zu groß. Experten der Bayerischen Landesanstalt für Gartenbau in Veitshöchheim zeigen die Top 5 der Hausbäume für kleine Gärten.

programme.title: SF unterwegs
programme.desc: Dichte Wälder, weite Seenlandschaften und Häuser wie aus dem Märchenbuch: Schweden gehört zu den populärsten europäischen Reisezielen. Die Reise beginnt in Motala am Göta-Kanal.

programme.title: Abenteuer Lappland - Die Husky-Tour des Lebens
programme.desc: Im Dezember 2019, kurz vor Weihnachten, nehmen sich fünf Abenteurer eine fünftägige Auszeit. Bei minus 30 Grad sind sie 200 Kilometer in der Wildnis Lapplands mit Schlittenhunden unterwegs.

programme.desc: Miss Jackson has invited a photographer to take pictures of her. It doesn't take long for the blonde bombshell to strip off and seduce Danny with her amazing body!

programme.desc: Ema Karter and Kiki Minaj are excited when Danny D invites them over. Although he's a mild-mannered husband with his wife, he likes to dominate his side chicks. (All 18+)
