programme.title: Sommar med Ernst
programme.desc: S8 E2Ernst gör klart gårdens kök och han vill skapa ett utrymme med högt bruksvärde. Snickarna Magnus och Johan bygger en köksö och pallar. Ernst förvandlar en gammal skänk till ett bakskåp. Han bygger även ett hängande disksställ och gör en grönsaksinläggning. \n\nTill sist inreder Ernst både kök och skafferi i en lantlig sommarstil och inviger köket med att laga potatisstomp och stekt abborre som han bjuder sina snickarkollegor på.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Vad blir det för mat-3Per Morbergs dotter Molly fyller år och hon får en rosa överraskning. Hon har bjudit in sina vänner på lunch som pappa Per ska tillaga. Det blir lasagne som är Mollys favoriträtt och tjejerna får göra sina egna fruktsmoothies.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S3 E10 — Vad blir det för mat-3Per Morberg och Inese ger sig ut i Trosa skärgård. De åker till sin favoritplats alldeles i närheten av Tullgarns slott. Med sig har de en potatis- och purjolökssoppa som Per gjort i förväg samt fiskspett som preparerats med en marinad à la Per.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain parts unknown
programme.desc: S12 E7 — Bourdains arvDet här avsnittet utforskar hur Anthony Bourdains unika blick och röst förändrade synen på mat, resor och kultur. Genom sitt sätt att berätta förnyade han tv-mediet och fick publiken att möta världen mer nyfiket, personligt och engagerat än tidigare.

programme.title: Leila bakar i Frankrike
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Leila bakar i Frankrike-1Programstart. Leila ställer till med sommarfest på sin veranda. Hon bjuder på cheesecake med rabarberkompott och desserten sabayonne med gratinerade färska bär. Dessutom får hennes gäster smaka på en chocolate pot de crème som serveras i en kopp.

programme.title: Leila bakar i Frankrike
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Leila bakar i Frankrike-1Leila Lindholm firar Frankrikes nationaldag i förskott med klassiska franska bakverk. Hon gör en lantlig fruktpaj och en fransk chokladtårta med mörk choklad. Hon besöker också ett crêperie och gräddar crêpes Suzette som flamberas i apelsinlikör.

programme.title: Det stora tårtslaget
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Det stora tårtslaget-3Temat är jorden runt och deltagarna formger en tårta med inspiration från ett land. Det blir bland annat Japan, Marocko och Norge i tårtformat.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Vad blir det för mat-4Per Moberg ger sig ut på sjön för att fånga strömming, men när fiskelyckan sviker tvingas han bege sig till fiskhandlaren för att få tag på den. Hemma i köket ute vid Tullgarns slott steker han upp dessa och serverar dem tillsammans med ett hemlagat potatismos.\n\nTill förrätten hämtar Per inspiration från den italienska ön Capri och gör en sallad med mozarella, paprika och kronärtskocka i olja. Som avslutning på middagen blir det en annorlunda dessert när han lagar en variant på klappgröt, som görs på mannagryn.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S4 E2 — Vad blir det för mat-4Med hjälp av sin familj lagar Per Morberg svensk husmanskost i form av isterband och stuvad potatis. Till efterrätt bakar han en svartvinbärspaj. Familjen får även en middagsgäst, Pers gode vän Bengt Frithiofsson, vinexpert och författare.

programme.title: Mandelmanns gård
programme.desc: S4 E8 — Avsnitt 8Säsongsavslutning. Nu gäller det att säkra upp matförrådet på gården, helst ända fram till midsommar. En jordkällare ska grävas och Marie lagar saffransstinna äppelmunkar. Hon hinner också med att spinna egen ull när fåren och getterna har friserats.

programme.title: Den stora matresan
programme.desc: S1 E2Per reser till Gotland och träffar gotlänningar med öga för lokala delikatesser. Han jagar kanin och får prova på drycken Dricko. Han lagar lamm på tre olika sätt och besöker en saffransodling och en ekologisk sparrisodling.

programme.title: Sommar med Ernst
programme.desc: S8 E3Ernst tar sig an Nymansgården på Björkskogsnäs och det blir ett rum med många funktioner, en matsalsdel, en läshörna och en lounge. Han klär om en fåtölj, gör en golvlampa av drivved och en vedförvaring i form av en piedestal. Han visar också hur man med enkla medel kan tillverka sina egna ramar. \n\nSnickarna Magnus och Johan sätter panel inne i salen och tillverkar en platsbyggd bokhylla. Ernst lagar dessutom kyckling med rostad paprika och gör egna chips som han bjuder sina kollegor på. Framför huset anlägger han två nya rabatter.

programme.title: Sommar med Ernst
programme.desc: S8 E4 — Episode 4Ruinen på Björkskogsnäs får nytt liv i form av ett utekök. Torpets nya veranda blir klar och till den tillverkar Ernst en vägglampett av koppar. Sedan är det dags att inviga uteköket med en bjudning där det serveras grillat lamm med fetaostkräm.

programme.title: Leila bakar i Frankrike
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Avsnitt 5Leila Lindholm firar fruntimmersveckan med att baka en tårta i trikolorens färger. Hon gör också fruktflarn med mandel och en fransk chokladtårta.

programme.title: Leila bakar i Frankrike
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Avsnitt 6Leila Lindholm bjuder på ostbricka med hemgjorda tillbehör. Hon bakar rosmarin- och parmesankex, potatisflarn med getost och en klassisk fransk mandel- och päronpaj, tarte bordalou.

programme.title: Det stora tårtslaget
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Avsnitt 4Temat är mat och deltagarna gör tårtor som ser ut som en maträtt eller grönsak. Det blir bland annat färggranna pumpor, en lyxig frukostbricka och en skimrande forell.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S4 E5 — Vad blir det för mat-4Per Morberg beger sig till granngården för att köpa grönsaker till kvällens middag. Han ska laga svensk husmanskost i form av kåldolmar och får tag i vitkål direkt ur jorden. Det finns även vaxbönor, som av kockar brukar betraktas som en delikatess. \n\nPers fru Inese har varit ute i skogen och plockat trattkantareller som de sedan gör soppa på.

programme.title: Vad blir det för mat
programme.desc: S4 E6 — Vad blir det för mat-4Per Morberg bjuder på en meny baserad på skaldjur. Till förrätt blir det gratinerad krabba och som huvudrätt en skaldjursrisotto på hummer och havskräftor. Till efterrätt serveras en fläderblomsparfait.

programme.title: Mandelmanns gård
programme.desc: S5 E2 — Avsnitt 2Trots dryga tjugo år på gården slutar Gustav och Marie aldrig att ta sig an nya projekt. Nytt för i år är växthuset som ska genomgå en stor förändring. När magen börjar kurrar bakar Marie bröd innan paret ger sig av för att hälsa på vännen Bo.

programme.title: Den stora matresan
programme.desc: S1 E4Per besöker Dalarna och Härjedalen. Ingalill Brus lagar Dalarnas nationalrätt, rårakor med fläsk, tillsammans med Per i Fulåbergs fäbod. Han besöker också byn Romarheden för att kärna smör av mjölk från fjällkor och äta pannkaka. \n\nPå Jönsgårdens bageri utanför Rättvik får han lära sig om bakning av Lisa Clason som bakar Tuttul, ett traditionellt tunnbröd. I Härjedalen driver Karin Nylén Paulsson Herrö Getgård tillsammans med sin man Tord Paulsson. Per får lära sig ysta getost och tar med sig ett par dessertostar till sin middag.

programme.title: Sommar med Ernst
programme.desc:
S8 E5Nymansgården får ett sovrum och Ernst pryder väggarna med egentillverkad och handmålad tapet där motivet är traktens originella orkidé, guckuskon. Han gör även ett sängöverkast och ett påslakan och en gammal järngrind blir en sänggavel. 

Snickarna Magnus och Johan gör i ordning klädkammaren och bygger ett nattduksbord. 

Ernst besöker den lokala konstnären Gerd Göran. Han lagar också frukost med bland annat kryddscones och halloncurd.

programme.title: Caught In The Net
programme.desc: S1 E3 — One Last PostNär 26-åriga Erica Crippen Crosby försvinner från sitt hem i New Jersey måste utredarna följa ett digitalt spår för att få fram sanningen om vad som hände henne.

programme.title: Breaking Homicide
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Lost In The WoodsUtredaren Derrick Levasseur och dr Kris Mohandie granskar olösta mordfall. De går igenom gammalt bevismaterial på nytt och försöker se till att brotten äntligen blir lösta.

programme.title: Jägarna
programme.desc: Efter ett skottdrama bestämmer sig polisen Erik för att flytta hem till Norrland och ett samhälle som styrs av oskrivna lagar.

programme.title: 10 000 Timmar
programme.desc: När Eric vinner en stor summa pengar bestämmer han sig för att satsa på drömmen att bli fotbollsproffs, trots att han är rätt gammal och inte är så vass. För enligt en bok som Eric har läst tar det bara 10 000 timmar att bli bra på vad som helst...

programme.title: Höstsonaten
programme.desc: Ingrid Bergman briljerar i Ingmar Bergmans film om det uppslitande förhållandet mellan en berömd pianist och hennes döttrar.

programme.title: Att angöra en brygga
programme.desc: Hasse och Tages berömda filmkomedi om fyra söndagsseglare som är på väg till Ensamholmen i Stockholms skärgård. Där väntar man med nykokta kräftor till kvällens stora kräftskiva - och ombord på båten finns spriten. Båten närmar sig ön, skymningen börjar falla och besättningen gör alltmer desperata försök att lägga till vid bryggan. Regi: Tage Danielsson. I rollerna: Monica Zetterlund, Birgitta Andersson, Katie Rolfsen, Hans Alfredson, Lars Ekborg, Gösta Ekman, Tage Danielsson, Hans "Hatte" Furuhagen m.fl.

programme.title: Håkan Bråkan & Josef
programme.desc: Håkan känner sig ignorerad av föräldrarna när han får ett nytt syskon men blir bästis med en sköldpadda som förstår hans dilemma.

programme.title: En enkel till Antibes
programme.desc: Änklingen George har fått nog av sin hemhjälp Maria som stjäl hans saker och sina vuxna barn som försöker sälja hans hus och komma över pengarna. Han bestämmer sig för att överraska dem med ett motdrag. George packar en väska och drar iväg på en svindlande resa. Han färdas genom sitt förflutna mot sina drömmars mål. Regi: Richard Hobert. I rollerna: Sven-Bertil Taube, Rebecca Ferguson, Malin Morgan, Dan Ekborg, Catherine Rouvel, m.fl.

programme.title: Bert - den siste oskulden
programme.desc: I "Bert - den siste oskulden" möter vi en hårt prövad kille. Han har hunnit börja i nionde klass och liksom de flesta killar i den åldern tänker han på tjejer. Hela tiden. När alla utom Bert blir ihop ser han nyinflyttade Victoria som den enda räddningen från en säker död som den siste oskulden i världen. Men Victoria blir kär i Carl-Philip, en tvålfager blondin med långt, svallande hår.

programme.title: Astrid Lindgrens jul
programme.desc: En samling julepisoder från åtta filmer efter Astrid Lindgrens älskade berättelser. Här möter du Pippi Långstrump och Herr Nilsson som bakar pepparkakor, men vi träffar också Ronja rövardotter, Madicken, Kajsa Kavat, Emil och alla på Saltkråkan.

programme.title: Repmånad
programme.desc: Svensk komedi med Lasse Åberg. Det är dags för repmånad för Jonsson och hans gamla lumparkompisar och de ser en chans att ha lite kul.

programme.title: Så ock på jorden
programme.desc: Svenskt drama med Frida Hallgren och Niklas Falk. Efter den älskade körledaren Daniels bortgång hamnar den lilla kören i norrländska Ljusåker i kris. Inte minst gäller detta Lena, körens sopran och även Daniels flickvän. Efterlängtad uppföljare till en av svensk films största publiksuccéer, den Oscarnominerade "Så som i himmelen". Regisserad av Kay Pollak.

programme.title: Mer om oss barn i Bullerbyn
programme.desc: Bullerbyn är en liten, liten by i Småland. Där ligger tre gårdar. I Mellangården bor Lisa med sina bröder Lasse och Bosse, i Norrgården bor systrarna Britta och Anna och i Sörgården bor Olle. Ja, och så Kerstin också, Olles lillasyster. Fler barn finns det inte i Bullerbyn, med det räcker? Det är höst och vinter och det bara vimlar av äventyr varje dag!

programme.title: Vingar av Glas
programme.desc: 18-åriga Nazli är född i Iran men uppvuxen i Sverige och kallar sig Sara för att smälta in. Hennes pappa vill att hon ska gifta sig med en iransk man, så när hon träffar sin svenske pojkvän Johan, blir situationen komplicerad.

programme.title: Sprängaren
programme.desc: När Christina Furhage, ansvarig för ett OS i Stockholm, sprängs i bitar på Victoriastadion inleder polisen en desperat mördarjakt. Samtidigt börjar journalisten Annika Bengtzon granska fallet och upptäcker samband som försätter henne i livsfara.

programme.title: Kurt Olsson - Filmen om mitt liv som mej själv
programme.desc: Berättelsen om den folkkäre Kurt Olsson som genom åren tycks haft sina fingrar med i det mesta, och på något sätt går allt snett.

programme.title: Kim Novak badade aldrig i Genesarets sjö
programme.desc: Drama efter Håkan Nessers roman som utspelar sig en sommar i början av 60-talet vid sommarstället Genesaret.

programme.title: Jägarna 2
programme.desc: Erik (Rolf Lassgård) är Rikskrims bästa förhörsledare. Ett brutalt mord på en ung kvinna tvingar honom att återvända till sina gamla hemtrakter och där jobba ihop med den motvillige polisen, Torsten (Peter Stormare). Det som först ser ut som en enkel mordhistoria visar sig snart ha både jägare och poliser inblandade och konflikten mellan Erik och Torsten fördjupas. När Erik upptäcker att hans egen brorson är inblandad utvecklas allt till en värre mardröm än han någonsin kunnat ana...

programme.title: Kontorstid
programme.desc: Bästisarna Lotta och Pernilla har samma jobb, men nu ska företaget förändras vilket får oväntade följder för dem båda.

programme.title: Ronja Rövardotter
programme.desc: En natt när åskan går över Mattisborgen föder Lovis sitt och Mattis första barn, flickan Ronja. Vid tio års ålder har hon blivit en orädd och nyfiken flicka. Hon blir vän med Birk, Borkahövdingens son, och de upplever hisnande äventyr tillsammans.

programme.title: Vinterviken
programme.desc: John-John bor i en förort söder om Stockholm med sin mamma, kriminella styvpappa och syster. I slutet av sommarlovet räddar han 10-åriga Patricia från att drunkna i Vinterviken. Hennes pappa bjuder som tack in John-John till den fina villa där han och hans familj bor. John-John blir genast kär i Patricias storasyster Elisabeth. Rent geografiskt är det bara en vik som skiljer dem åt, men förutsättningarna för deras kärlek kunde inte vara sämre.

programme.title: G - som i gemenskap
programme.desc: Svensk 80-talsklassiker om tre killar i 16-årsåldern som ser fram emot sommarlovet efter nian med blandade känslor. Kim är kär i Mia men har också andra känslor, Robban har hoppat av skolan, och Alexander hoppas slå igenom som sångare.

programme.title: Fyra år till
programme.desc: Alldeles nyss var folkpartiledaren David Holst Sveriges hetaste politiker, stilig, rolig, populär och självskriven som landets nästa statsminister. När David plötsligt en dag blir kär är inte problemet att han redan är gift. Problemet är att han blir handlöst förälskad i Socialdemokraternas fruktade statssekreterare, Martin. Hur ska David förklara för sin fru och närmaste medarbetare Fia att han blivit kär - i en sosse?

programme.title: Kådisbellan
programme.desc: Guldbagge-belönad svensk dramakomedi om Roland som växer upp i 20-talets Stockholm med sin brokiga familj.

programme.title: En man som heter Ove
programme.desc: 59-årige Ove är kvarterets vresige ordningsman som avsatts som ordförande i bostadsrättsföreningen, men som ändå styr kvarteret med järnhand. När Parvaneh med familj flyttar in i radhuset mittemot och backar in i Oves brevlåda blir det upptakten till en komisk och hjärtvärmande historia om oväntad vänskap, kärlek och vikten av att omge sig med ordentliga verktyg. Baserad på Fredrik Backmans succéroman.

programme.title: Comedy Queen
programme.desc: 13-åriga Sasha har bestämt sig för att bli ståuppkomiker. Mest av allt vill hon få sin pappa att skratta, som gråter i duschen när han tror att ingen hör. Hemma påminner allt om mamma som inte längre lever och bakom ögonen bränner de livsfarliga tårarna. Men Sasha vägrar gråta. I hemlighet skriver hon en lista på allt hon måste göra för att överleva sorgen: raka av sig håret, sluta läsa böcker, tacka nej till världens gulligaste hundvalp och framförallt, bli en - Comedy Queen.

programme.title: Lotta på Bråkmakargatan
programme.desc: Astrid Lindgrens lilla Lotta är snart fem år och tycker inte om när någon säger åt henne att hon är för liten för vissa saker, som att cykla.

programme.title: Adam och Eva
programme.desc: När Adam och Eva möttes var det kärlek vid första ögonkastet. Deras kärleksaffär fick en dramatisk start, vilket borde garantera evig lycka. Men efter fyra år som gifta har passionen lagt sig och de har olika idéer om hur framtiden ska se ut.

programme.title: Paradiset
programme.desc: Kvällstidningsjournalisten Annika Bengtzon misstänker att ett skyddshem för misshandlade kvinnor är något annat än det utger sig för.

programme.title: God afton, herr Wallenberg
programme.desc: I Budapest kämpar den svenske diplomaten Raoul Wallenberg, under några veckor i andra världskrigets slutskede, för att rädda en grupp judar som gripits i en razzia. Samtidigt försöker han förhindra den totala utplåningen av stadens getto.

programme.title: En förälskelse
programme.desc: Romantiskt drama om att hitta kärleken. Simon och Ingrid lär sig den hårda vägen att även när livet verkar ha svängt färdigt kan ny kärlek spira.

programme.title: Hypnotisören
programme.desc: En mörk decembernatt blir hypnotisören Erik Maria Bark väckt av ett telefonsamtal från ett Stockholmssjukhus. Kriminalkommissarie Joona Linna ber om hans hjälp att behandla en medvetslös patient som lider av akut trauma.

programme.title: Bränn alla mina brev
programme.desc: Efter ett gräl med sin fru inser Alex Schulman att han måste ta itu med sin vrede. En ilska som gått i arv i generationer. Släktens alla konflikter och vendettor tycks börja hos en och samma person: morfar Sven Stolpe. I "Bränn alla mina brev" följer vi Karin och Sven Stolpe, och den korta affär Karin hade med Olof Lagercrantz i början av 1930-talet som skapade svallvågor över årtionden.

programme.title: Buss till Italien
programme.desc: Körledaren Ylva sitter i en buss på väg till Italien tillsammans med sin kör. Några av dem längtar efter att få träffa den lokale borgmästaren, andra vill få en gratis semester, några vill bara sjunga, men de flesta av dem vill fly vardagen.

programme.title: Medicinen
programme.desc: Johanna (Helena Bergström) blir försöksperson för en ny medicin som ger oanade biverkningar, i denna komedi av Colin Nutley.

programme.title: Ingen rövare finns i skogen
programme.desc: Peter har varit ute i skogen och levt rövare. Det var en lång stund sedan mormor bad honom komma in. Mormor är inte i köket, det är mörkt. I förmaket står mammas gamla dockskåp och i salongen sitter en liten docka, Mimmi.

programme.title: Karlsson på taket - världens bästa Karlsson
programme.desc: Lillebror är alldeles ensam. Ja, han har förstås mamma, pappa och sina syskon men de är alltid upptagna med något viktigare. En dag möter lillebror Karlsson, en rund liten man i sina bästa år, som bor på taket och kan flyga! Lillebror och Karlsson på taket blir bästa vänner och har väldigt roligt när de filurar, som Karlsson kallar det. När Lillebror berättar för mamma och pappa om Karlsson, så tror de inte att han finns – till den dagen de själva får möta världens bästa Karlsson...

programme.title: Ett öga rött
programme.desc: "Ett öga rött" är en färgsprakande filmberättelse som är fritt inspirerad av den kritikerrosade storsäljaren av Jonas Hassen Khemiri.

programme.title: Hip hip hurra!
programme.desc: Verklighetsbaserat drama från Skagen i slutet av 1800-talet. Konstnären Sören Kröyer har kommit till konstnärsparet Anna och Michael Ancher för att måla - och för att leva. Kring honom samlas så småningom konstnärer och även andra människor.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — No Friend of MineTony och Ziva spårar upp den svårfångade hackaren, men det slutar med att de samarbetar när Interpol närmar sig.

programme.title: Abby Hatcher

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren
programme.desc: S14 E5 — Dora's Fantastic Gymnastics AdventureDora måste leta rätt på sitt regnbågsband så hon kan vara med i den stora gymnastikshowen och framföra sin speciella Ribbon-dans.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S4 E8 — Skyfire CycleKomediserie. Den Emmybelönade komikern Andy Samberg spelar en omogen men framgångsrik polis i denna charmiga sitcom. Jake Peralta (Samberg) är begåvad nog att varken ha behövt arbeta hårt eller följa reglerna under sin karriär. Kanske är det därför han har lyckats gripa flest brottslingar av alla sina kollegor. Vad som är säkert är att han har varit bortskämd under hela sitt yrkesliv. Nu får polisstationen en ny befälhavare, Ray Holt (Braugher), som är fast besluten att följa reglerna till punkt och pricka. Jakes kollegor tävlar mot varandra, sjunger karaoke, flörtar och blandar sig i varandras privatliv - men när allt kommer omkring är de goda vänner som tar hand om varandra. Samtidigt kämpar de till det yttersta för att skydda sina medmänniskor i Brooklyn.

programme.desc: The impending arrival of Ally and Doug’s baby launches Joy into a frenzy of preparations; Doug’s relapse into his sit-com fantasy forces Dr. Bialik to provide a highly unusual treatment.

programme.desc: Amidst Ally’s series of false labor pains, the Starks are enlisted to attend a surprise party that Whitey hopes will kill off his aging and irascible Uncle Rudolph.

programme.desc: When Joy wants to take a vacation at the beach, Eddie must buy a student's cooperation to get a pay raise that Ms. Duffy has been withholding.

programme.desc: Paul and Jamie miss out on a friend's important Valentine's Day party when they accidentally lock themselves in their bathroom. They vainly try ramming the door, dropping S.O.S. notes out the window and yelling for their lazy dog, but they finally resign themselves to their fate -- and discover more about each other than either cared to know.

programme.title: The Wedding Affair
programme.desc: Paul and Jamie are overdressed and overstressed when they attend a friend's wedding, where Paul blurts out an embarrassing revelation about the blushing bride. But later, a contrite Jamie confesses some secrets of her own -- intimate details Paul wishes he had never heard.

programme.title: Weekend Getaway
programme.desc: During a long weekend, stressed-out Paul and workaholic Jamie escape the city and try to unwind in a rustic country inn, but the clean air, beautiful scenery and quiet nights nearly drive the New Yorkers stir crazy. Their condition is only made worse by the knowledge that neurotic Lisa is minding their apartment.

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: A protective Jamie shares her doubts with Paul when her neurotic sister Lisa gleefully decides to move in with her too-perfect English boyfriend after a week of courtship. And Jamie's fears are not calmed when she learns that Bluebeard's three previous wives all met bizarre and untimely ends.

programme.title: The Billionaire
programme.desc: Paul is flattered when an eccentric billionaire offers him a ton of money to produce a documentary film about his life. Assisted by Steven, his keenly observant film editor, Paul, traipses after his loony subject and amasses miles of film -- but his biggest creative challenge is how to evict his chummy client when he moves in with him and Jamie.

programme.title: The Man Who Said Hello
programme.desc: Paul is mortified when his star struck father calls out to talk show host Regis Philbin across a crowded theater, but his embarrassment mushrooms when an amused Regis asks the chatty old man to appear on his talk show. And when shy Paul refuses to join his pop and Jamie on camera, his cousin Ira fills in and pretends to be Paul -- all of which confuses poor Regis.

programme.title: The Spy Girl Who Loved Me
programme.desc: Paul nearly drools with excitement when Jamie invites him to dinner with her client Diane Caldwell (Barbara Feldon), a sexy TV spy/heroine from the 1960s who inspired his adolescent fantasies. But he gets jealous when his equally bewitched cousin Ira horns in and disappears into the night with the slinky spy lady.

programme.title: Happy Anniversary

But because she's the first to produce a signed retainer, Jane is given the go-ahead to represent Annie. programme.title: Crushed
programme.desc: As Jane struggles to come to terms with Owen's disappearance, her mother Elaine shows up asking her to help Chloe Surnow, a teenage girl whom Jane used to babysit and who's been accused of murdering her classmate Brittney Hollis. While meeting with Chloe's mother Peg and younger sister Michelle, Jane learns that Brittney accused Chloe of cheating on an exam to get her thrown off their high school swim team and open up a spot for her to compete in the state championships. But after Jane prevents a potentially incriminating text message from being entered into evidence, the prosecutor strikes back and seeks to try Chloe as an adult. Meanwhile, Parker enlists Grayson to woo Gina Blunt – a lawyer whom Teri used to work for and doesn't trust – to repay Luke's lifesaving loan to the firm and to become its new creditor. When she's offered a chance to plead guilty in exchange for five years in prison, Chloe insists on proving her innocence. While Jane can't get anyone to back up Chloe's alibi, she does find evidence that Chloe's sister Michelle was at school when Brittany was murdered. And though Chloe tells Jane not to implicate her sister, co-counsel Kim doesn't hesitate to point the finger at Michelle once they are back in court. But after the D.A. agrees to drop the charges against Chloe in order to go after her sister, Michelle disappears. Meanwhile, because the firm cannot afford to take the case pro bono, Kim orders Teri to find Chloe and Michelle's long-missing father in order to place a lien on the child support he owes. As Teri continues looking for Mr. Surnow, the memories of his sudden disappearance years ago lead Jane to suspect Peg killed both her husband and Brittany. After tracking down Michelle and explaining the predicament she's in, Jane alerts the police, and their discovery of her missing husband's remains in her backyard prompt Peg to confess to both murders. Finally, after finding evidence that Owen has left Jane for an old girlfriend, Teri warn

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: When Jane takes Grayson to Stanford to speak to Professor Gretchen Daily's law class, student and legal clinic volunteer Veronika Kramer asks for help suing EastBay Semiconductor for a client's unpaid wages. Though Professor Daily doesn't have time to supervise Veronika, she recommends her former star pupil, Jane. After Veronika's client Alison Thomas is arrested for child endangerment, Jane and Grayson agree to assist with her defense. Suspecting that Alison's son was poisoned by methanol, a chemical that she regularly used at work, they decide to sue EastBay, only to discover that Professor Daily is the company's lawyer. Meanwhile, Parker asks Kim to help their new partner Gina Blunt defend Marty Sadler after one of his food trucks hits a man in a wheelchair. And with Jane out of town, Luke helps an anxious Stacy prepare for a small business awards banquet. In court, Professor Daily points to several other possible sources of methanol contamination in Alison's home, and even suggests that her son's poisoning may have been a desperate attempt to deal with the pressures of being a single mom. But after Daily coerces Veronika into accepting a meager settlement for her client, Jane argues that the law student can't enter into the agreement without her supervision. Back in Los Angeles, Kim refuses Warren Patton's demand of half a million dollars, even though Sadler and Gina want to settle the case out of court in order to avoid disclosing his financial statements. Meanwhile, as a Stanford tradition leads to Jane and Grayson kissing in the school's quad, Stacy balks at Luke's criticism of her acceptance speech. But after Stacy learns that no one takes the awards ceremony seriously, Luke steps in to save the day. programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. After Teri is declared the winner of a song contest, she asks Luke for a loan to finance a recording. When he looks into the record company, however, Luke discovers that Teri is the target of a con man. And when Luke takes her to a performance given by another of the contest winners, Teri learns the truth about the con. Finally, though Caitlin has already disposed of Scott's ashes, Jane tricks her into revealing what she did by claiming that Kathy kept some of the remains

programme.title: Lady Parts
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Family Matters
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

programme.title: Pick's And Pakes
programme.desc: Alleging that Vanden Pharmaceuticals' antidepressant Aprox caused his client Sheila Reese to miscarry, celebrity trial lawyer Lawrence Brand arranges for Jane to help in his lawsuit. When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.desc: Eddie is stunned after Joy sets up his old college roommate, Webby, with her friend Denise.

programme.title: Summer Of Love
programme.desc: Eddie's summer vacation woes are challenged once Allison and her laid back boyfriend, Doug, arrive at home.

programme.title: Perfomance Anxiety
programme.desc: As a birthday gift reveals just how little confidence Jeff has in Steph being able to complete her master's thesis, Eddie confesses that he has always found Joy's singing to be over the top, while she complains about his corny jokes and celebrity impersonations.

programme.title: Daddy's Girl
programme.desc: An unexpected break up with her boyfriend during her first holiday visit from college shows Eddie and Joy that their daughter, Allison, isn't the girl they remember.

programme.title: Fight Friend
programme.desc: Eddie must go up against Joy and her friend in an effort to get out of having to attend a marriage workshop.

programme.title: It's A Wrap
programme.desc: Paul finishes his film as Jamie tries to plot her own future.

programme.title: Surprise
programme.desc: Paul's birthday surprise for Jamie goes awry.

programme.title: A Pair Of Hearts
programme.desc: A mysterious trip to Atlantic City yields Ira's long-held secret.

programme.title: Edna Returns
programme.desc: Paul mediates a spat between Jamie and her woeful and unemployed sister Lisa, after Lisa's psychologist publishes a case-study book in which her patient holds Jamie partially responsible for her sad-sack life.

programme.title: Paul Is Dead
programme.desc: Over the weekend, Paul and Jamie are stranded without cash or credit when their charge cards are confiscated after a computer glitch mistakenly confuses him with another Paul Buchman -- recently deceased.

programme.title: Same Time Next Week
programme.desc: Paul's absence makes Jamie's heart grow fonder when he is hired to shoot a documentary in Chicago for six weeks. He flies home on the weekends for passionate reunions, but one intimate weekend is jeopardized when Paul's abrasive mother comes knocking -- after Jamie told her that Paul was still out of town.

programme.title: The Late Show
programme.desc: Ex-lovers Fran and Ira, desperate to keep Fran's suspected pregnancy under wraps, each secretly tell Paul and Jamie a different story, resulting in a cascade of mistaken identities, a paint-splattered room, and an uncooperative pregnancy test.

programme.title: Instant Karma
programme.desc: Jamie teaches her Valentine, Paul, that their love for each other can survive even the worst case of bad karma.

programme.title: It's A Wrap
programme.desc: Paul finishes his film as Jamie tries to plot her own future.

programme.title: Jane's Getting Married
programme.desc: Though she's diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, Hannah Baker refuses surgery, preferring to take advantage of the increased intelligence it's given her. Worried that she has only six months to live, her husband Mark asks their old friend Grayson to help change her mind. However, when neuroscientist Bradley Alton convinces her that she could live for many years, Hannah says she's leaving Mark to start a new life. Meanwhile, after her mom comes to help with the wedding, Jane's irritation with her meddling drives Elaine to leave. And as Jane struggles to make amends, she also opens a rift with Grayson after accusing him of not being able to move on from Deb's death. And after Luke inadvertently reveals that Kim is pregnant, she tells Parker that the baby isn't his. After a fan confesses that a song lyric inspired her to cut the brake line in Paige McBride's ex-boyfriend's car, the country singer is accused of soliciting to have him killed. But after Stacy finds evidence that the obsessed fan is lying, she and Kim prove that Chase Black set Paige up in order to sue her for $1 million. Meanwhile, after the judge refuses to treat the Bakers' wedding vows as a legal contract, Jane and Grayson ask Dr. Alton to level with Hannah about her chances. And though Alton refuses, once they discover that he's already scheduled her autopsy for his research, Hannah sees she's been duped and agrees to the surgery after all. After asking her mom to come back and help her get ready for the wedding, Jane realizes that she still has unresolved feelings for Grayson. Watching from heaven, the Old Jane tricks Guardian Angel Fred into letting her return to Earth just as the wedding is getting underway. So when a stuck door conveniently keeps her from walking down the aisle, Grayson comes to the rescue and admits that he only got over Deb's death after falling in love with Jane. programme.title: Back From The Dead
programme.desc: As she looks for Owen following his wedding day heart attack, Jane fights to stop a drug company from discontinuing the drug trial that is keeping an eight-year-old cancer patient alive. Meanwhile, Kim represents a high school friend whose vengeful ex has posted nude photos of her on the Internet.

programme.title: The Real Jane
programme.desc: After taking over the body of a deceased lingerie model, Old Jane returns to enlist Jane in a death row appeal that was dropped when she died. Meanwhile, Grayson and Kim represent a mattress salesman who was fired for wearing women's clothes at work.

programme.title: Surrogates
programme.desc: As Jane reluctantly agrees to help a jilted bride-to-be sue her ex-fiancé, Grayson and Kim represent a surrogate mother who’s been cheated by a shady lawyer.

programme.title: Angels on Ice, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Part 2 - Just before the opening of a big ice show, the two stars, Jack and Helene, disappear, and since the promoter is a friend of Charlie's, Kris and Kelly start practicing their skating so they can join the ice act.

programme.title: Pretty Angels All in a Row
programme.desc: At a beauty contest, whenever contestants and judges start finding deadly spiders in their beds, it usually means someone wants to win the contest dishonestly.

programme.title: Angel Flight
programme.desc: Angela Hart directs a training school for airline stewardesses, and lately someone en scaring her half to death.

programme.title: Circus of Terror
programme.desc: Yanos is a true gypsy circus master. He refuses to call the police despite the many attempts to ruin his circus -- animals let loose from cages, tents burned, ropes mysteriously cut.

programme.title: Angel in Love
programme.desc: Sabrina falls in love with one Doug O'Neal, at Utopia West, a resort where people go to learn how to touch and feel.

programme.title: Angels in Paradise
programme.desc: Part 1 - The Angels may finally see the man they work for -- Charlie's been kidnapped and they must fly to Hawaii to rescue him.

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Angels
programme.desc: Suspicious is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their Celestial Research Foundation, in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the doctor tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels On The Air
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the air report, and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his family in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Baby
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible home for girls, Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a baby-maker for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels In The Wings
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Magic Fire
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper, guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on Charlie's Angels. The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious demonstration of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels On Horseback
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Game, Set, Death
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' Hermosa Cup tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible home for girls, Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a baby-maker for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels In The Wings
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Magic Fire
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper, guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on Charlie's Angels. The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious demonstration of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels On Horseback
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Game, Set, Death
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' Hermosa Cup tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Angels
programme.desc: Suspicious is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their Celestial Research Foundation, in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the doctor tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Hours Of Desperation
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not hired exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Diamond In The Rough
programme.desc: Freddie the Fox Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous Light of Arabia diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones

programme.title: Angels In The Backfield
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's win-at-any-cost attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: The Sandcastle Murders
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris stalk the sands of Malibu Beach to track down the surfside killer of several young women in Sandcastles Murders. Police have virtually no leads in their investigation of the Sandcastle Murders. When one of the victims turns out to be a personal friend of Kris, boss Charlie give the girls permission to handle their own investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Blues
programme.desc: Stunned by the mysterious death of his favorite folk-rock singer, Charlie sends Kelly, Kris and Sabrina to find everyone who spent time with the victim the night she pied in Angel Blues. Amy Waters is one of the most popular singers in the country. Shortly after freaking out during a concert performance, Amy calls her dad to say she's coming home by cab to get straight. But Amy makes a few stops along the way. One of the last people to see her alive is Lenny, the taxi driver Kris becomes acquainted with during the investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Mother Goose Is Running For His Life
programme.desc: Leland Swinnerton, 70-year-old president of a huge toy corporation, is known to everyone as Mother Goose. He goes to Charlie's Angels for assistance when someone tries to sabotage the company toys by blowing up the corporate offices, causing at least one death. Sabrina, posing as a secretary from Hong Kong, becomes friendly with Gordon Roclair, the brilliant but crazy design director. Roclair confides to Sabrina that he hates Mother Goose, and is working for Tony Phelan, a gangster with plans to gain control of the company. With Sabrina tagging along as partner, Roclair installs secret microphones around the factory, so that Phelan can hear all the latest corporate decisions. It is a simple matter for the Angels to sabotage the saboteurs by changing the location of the microphones. Instead of picking up important conversations in Mother Goose's office, Phelan hears the secretary talking about her flowers. By planing a microphone of their own in Phelan's truck, the Angels pick up all the wire tap communications and hear the gangsters' plans. This mike is especially useful when Phelan's accomplice, Orwell, discovers the identity of Kelly, who had been working with him as a bugging expert. Orwell forces Kelly at gunpoint to drive the truck into the country, but Bosley and Kris are right behind, listening to every word. In the end, Roclair and Phelan are completely confused. Roclair finds Mother Goose's secret plans for the new Christmas toys with Sabrina's help, but Kris switches them for a set of useless vacuum cleaner blueprints. Phelan and his hoods chase Roclair, believing he doublecrossed them. In the confusion, a booby--trapped toy cannon in the factory shoots at Roclair and he falls, only from fright, because Kris had stopped up the barrel with bubblegum. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their in

programme.title: Little Angels Of The Night
programme.desc: When two blonde call girls are brutally murdered in Mrs. Dolly Smith's apartment building, Kelly and Kris reluctantly go undercover as prostitutes and move into Mrs. Smith's establishment. On their first day at work, the trio arouses suspicion with their clever tactics to avoid meeting with customers. But the Angels are more interested in the Italian restaurant across the street, where Freddie, the macho delivery boy works. He brings pizza to the girls in the building almost every day, and always acts aggressive and threatening. Then Bonnie, another blond girl, is attacked but manages to escape. When she says her assailant smelled like a restaurant, it looks like Freddie is the man. Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Jade Trap
programme.desc: Charlie uses the Angels plus his own priceless collection of jade as bait to trip up an acrobatic jewel thief and a killer in THE JADE TRAP. Gigolo Denny Railsback murders wealthy Julie Redmond when she becomes disenchanted. As Denny is doing away with Julie in the living room, cat burglar Ted Machlin is in the bedroom stealing jewels. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. The setting is a posh residential hotel into which Kelly checks as a lonely heiress, Kris as a Swedish movie star and Bosley as a flamboyant auctioneer. Sabrina does her sleuthing as a hotel employee. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie; an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David-Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.
